identity.rule: artifact_id = fg2- + sha256(identity.basis); every hash is of the in-memory bytes actually analysed

reasons.detail: jump at 0x401320 to known function start 0x401060 treated as call+return
2 call(s); callee effects are not modelled (only noreturn of listed imports)

qualification.note: status=ok means an export was produced; it is not semantic verification

image.snapshot: single read through one descriptor, fstat-stable before and after; path not reopened
image.loader: ghx SnapImage: PT_LOAD file bytes of the snapshot, zero memsz tail, nothing else; data reads never padded
image.address_basis: link-time virtual addresses from ELF program headers; no runtime load bias applied

language.spec_source: worker-private snapshot taken at worker start; hashes are of the snapshot bytes

instruction_admission.rule: an instruction is admitted only if every byte of [addr, addr+length) is a file byte of one PF_X PT_LOAD (and, with strict bounds, inside [entry, entry+size)); decoder prefetch padding is never evidence

high_pcode.note: alive ops after the full decompile action; op ids are PcodeOp creation times, varnode ids are Varnode creation indices; both are stable only within this artifact_id

pseudocode.position_basis: line is 1-based, col is 0-based byte offset, both in pseudocode.text
pseudocode.address_map_status: partial: tokens carry an op only when the printer attached one; syntax tokens have none

source_lines.reason: native worker has no DWARF line reader; image has_debug_info is reported but not consumed

unresolved_relationships: high_op_to_raw_op: only instruction-level (pc) link; decompiler transforms do not preserve raw op index
pseudocode_struct_block: printer block refs index structured blocks, not basic blocks
types: no DWARF/type database; all non-primitive types are decompiler inferred

import_policy.prototypes: listed imports get locked C prototypes; other callees are inferred by the decompiler
